name: Mitsumine Aira
source:
One of the "dead" who becomes an ally of [url=/c81471]Teru[/url].

A true gyaru through and through - bleached hair, dramatic eyes, and model height to boot. Her experience as a reader model isn't just for show - she's got the looks to back it up.

Think street-smart meets a loyal friend - she's straightforward and rough around the edges but with a heart of gold. While she can work a room like nobody's business, don't expect her to win any vocabulary contests.

"You totally died today, didn't you? Somewhere out there."

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
